title: Oddrake
description: Allows you to farm Oddishes in Cobblemon. Introduces Oddish food items and tools
body:
Intended to be used with [Grow-A-Mon](https://modrinth.com/mod/growamon) to grow an **Oddish** or **Oddrake** food item...

## Overview
### Finding Seeds

- Base: 1 in 850 chance to drop from breaking short grass.
- Shiny: 1 in 2,000 chance to drop from breaking short grass.

### Growth Requirements

Only grows during sunny days:
- Needs sky light level 8 or higher (can't be grown underground)
- Stops growing during rain or nighttime
- Grows 50% slower on moist farmland
- Can be grown on Dirt and Grass blocks

### Harvesting

Mature crops (ages 9-15) drop 1 Oddrake food. Fortune doesn't change this.

Oddrake food: don't eat it, you can but I don't recommend it.

Can craft 1 Oddrake into 2 seeds.

With [Grow-A-Mon](https://modrinth.com/mod/growamon) installed, the crop will spawn an Oddish if broken on age 15.

Harvest Oddishes will have a minimum of 15 IVs in each category. so it'll be decent.

### Additional Content


<details>
<summary>Pan Flute (v1.2)</summary>

- Crafting the Flute
  - Crafted using 1 Oddrake, 5 Sticks and 2 Bamboo
  - When crafted has 1 or 2 random music genre enchants

The Pan Flute inflicts effects on entities nearby including the user unless they're wearing a leather helmet


<details>
<summary>Music Genre Enchants</summary>

- Dark Ambient I > IV (Poison)
- Lo-fi I > IV (Slowness)
- Rock 'n Roll (Ignites nearby entities)
- Pop I > II (Speed)
- Epic Orchestral I > II (Resistance)
- Screamo I > II (Wither)
- Progressive House I > IV (Regen)
- Folk I > II (Instant Health)
- Heavy Metal I > II (Strength)
- Synthwave (Night Vision)
- Minimal Ambient (Invisibility)
- Dream Pop (Levitation)
- Slowcore I > II (Weakness)

Some of the enchants are mutually exclusive, for example you cannot have Poison and Wither on at the same time.

You also can't have a damage and a buff like Wither and Instant Health

You may get a `Slowness + Regen`, `Ignite + Levitation`, and or just `Strengh` these are examples though, there are a bunch of combinations

</details>

Repair the Pan Flute in the Crafting table using:
- Pan Flute
- 3 Bamboo (3 Sticks in v1.2.1)

</details>
